questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty cistern in 65 minutes and 26 minutes, respectively. Both Pipe A and Pipe B are opened together. After how much time should Pipe B be turned off so that the empty cistern is completely filled in a total of 30 minutes?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take total work = LCM(65,26) = 130

A = 2 units/min, B = 5 units/min

A works 30 min ⇒ work = 60 units

Remaining = 130 − 60 = 70 units ⇒ done by B

Time = 70 ÷ 5 = 14 min

**∴ Answer = 14 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pipe A fills in 65 min, Pipe B fills in 26 min

Total time = 30 min

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let B works for x minutes

⇒ Work by A in 30 min = 30 × 2 = 60 units

⇒ Work by B in x min = 5x units

⇒ Total work = 130 units

⇒ 60 + 5x = 130

⇒ 5x = 70

⇒ x = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Method

Taking LCM converts fractions into whole numbers for easy solving.

Efficiency Concept

Efficiency = Work done per minute.

Partial Work

One pipe may stop earlier, so split work accordingly.

questions.question: In a right circular cylinder, diameter of the base is 21 cm. If eight times the sum of the areas of its two circular faces is five times the area of its curved surface, find the volume of the cylinder (in cm³ ). (Take pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diameter = 21 ⇒ r = 10.5 cm

Condition ⇒ 8(2πr²) = 5(2πrh)

⇒ 16πr² = 10πrh ⇒ h = 1.6r = 16.8 cm

Volume = πr²h = (22/7)×(10.5)²×16.8

**∴ Answer = 5821.2 cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter = 21 cm ⇒ radius r = 10.5 cm

8 × (sum of areas of two circular faces) = 5 × curved surface area

**Formula used:**

Area of two bases = 2πr², Curved surface area = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8 × (2πr²) = 5 × (2πrh)

⇒ 16πr² = 10πrh

⇒ 16r = 10h

⇒ h = 16r/10 = 1.6r

⇒ h = 1.6 × 10.5 = 16.8 cm

⇒ Volume = πr²h

⇒ = (22/7) × (10.5)² × 16.8

⇒ = (22/7) × 110.25 × 16.8

⇒ = 5821.2 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 5821.2 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Formulas

Volume = πr²h, Curved surface area = 2πrh

Base Area

Area of two circular faces = 2πr²

Key Trick

Cancel π and simplify before substituting values.

questions.question: (1)/(20) is what percentage of (11)/(60) ? (Round off to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find what percentage 1/20 is of 11/60, we find their ratio directly:

Ratio = (1/20) ÷ (11/60) = 1/20 × 60/11 = 3/11

We know the fraction 1/11 is equivalent to 9.09%.

Therefore, 3/11 = 3 × 9.09% = 27.27%

**∴ The correct answer is 27.27%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Value to be expressed = 1/20

Base value = 11/60

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

 
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 Value: 3/60
 

 
 Base: 11/60
 

 
 Percentage = (3 ÷ 11) × 100 ≈ 27.27%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Required Percentage = (1/20 ÷ 11/60) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (1/20 × 60/11) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (3/11) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 300 ÷ 11

⇒ 300 ÷ 11 = 27.2727...

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 27.27%.

**∴ The correct answer is 27.27%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base Value in Percentages

The value appearing after the word 'of' is universally taken as the base value. Percentage is calculated as (Part ÷ Base) × 100.

Common Fraction to Percentage Conversions

Memorizing standard fractions helps drastically speed up calculations during exams: 1/9 ≈ 11.11%, 1/11 ≈ 9.09%, and 1/12 ≈ 8.33%.

Percentage Change

Percentage change represents the degree of change over time and is calculated as [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100.

questions.question: A train passes a station platform in 60 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 40 seconds. If the speed of the train is 63 km/hr, calculate the length of the platform.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = 63 km/hr = 17.5 m/s

Train length = 17.5 × 40 = 700 m

Platform + train = 17.5 × 60 = 1050 m

Platform length = 1050 − 700 = 350 m

**∴ Answer = 350 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time to cross man = 40 sec

Time to cross platform = 60 sec

Speed = 63 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert speed ⇒ 63 × 5/18 = 17.5 m/s

⇒ Length of train = 17.5 × 40 = 700 m

⇒ Train + platform = 17.5 × 60 = 1050 m

⇒ Platform length = 1050 − 700 = 350 m

**∴ The correct answer is 350 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Train Concept

Crossing a man ⇒ distance = train length

Platform Case

Distance = train length + platform length

Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18

questions.question: The mode of the observations 21, 29, 35, 24, 25, 33, 24, 23, 26, 28, 35, 27, 20, 35 and 20 is:4288
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode of a dataset is the observation that appears most frequently.

By visually scanning the given numbers, we observe that 35 appears 3 times.

The numbers 20 and 24 appear 2 times each, while all other numbers appear only once.

Since 35 has the highest frequency, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 21, 29, 35, 24, 25, 33, 24, 23, 26, 28, 35, 27, 20, 35, 20

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The observation with the highest frequency in the given data set.

 Highest Frequency = 3 (for Observation 35)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us count the frequency of each unique observation in the dataset:

⇒ Observation 20 occurs 2 times.

⇒ Observation 24 occurs 2 times.

⇒ Observation 35 occurs 3 times.

⇒ Observations 21, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, and 33 occur 1 time each.

⇒ Comparing the counts, the maximum frequency is 3.

Mean

The mean is the average of all observations, calculated as the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations.

Median

The median is the middle value when the data set is arranged in ascending or descending order. If the number of observations is even, it is the average of the two middle values.

Empirical Relationship

The mean, median, and mode are connected by the standard formula for moderately skewed distributions: Mode ≈ 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

questions.question: The monthly incomes of two friends Mukund and Sachin are in the ratio 5 : 9 respectively and each of them saves ₹45,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 1 : 3, then find the monthly income of Mukund (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income ratio = 5 : 9, Expenditure ratio = 1 : 3

Savings same ⇒ (Income − Expenditure) equal

So 5x − y = 9x − 3y ⇒ 2y = 4x ⇒ y = 2x

Savings = 5x − 2x = 3x = 45000

x = 15000 ⇒ Mukund income = 5x = 75000

**∴ Answer = ₹75000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income ratio = 5 : 9

Expenditure ratio = 1 : 3

Savings = ₹45000 each

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let incomes = 5x and 9x

⇒ Let expenditures = y and 3y

⇒ Equal savings ⇒ 5x − y = 9x − 3y

⇒ 2y = 4x ⇒ y = 2x

⇒ Savings = 5x − 2x = 3x

⇒ 3x = 45000 ⇒ x = 15000

⇒ Mukund income = 5x = 75000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹75000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Concept

Savings are equal ⇒ equate differences.

Important Tip

Use different variables for income and expenditure.

Final Insight

Solve using equation rather than direct assumption.

questions.question: The price of a branded pen is ₹180 and that of a pencil is ₹3.50. If the total price of x branded pens and y pencils is ₹935 and x + y = 15, then what is the value of (x² + y²) ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From earlier result ⇒ x = 5, y = 10

x² + y² = 25 + 100 = 125

**∴ Answer = 125**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

180x + 3.5y = 935

x + y = 15

**Calculation:**

⇒ Multiply first equation by 2:

360x + 7y = 1870

⇒ Substitute y = 15 − x:

360x + 7(15 − x) = 1870

360x + 105 − 7x = 1870

353x = 1765 ⇒ x = 5

y = 15 − 5 = 10

x² + y² = 25 + 100 = 125

**∴ The correct answer is 125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equation Solving

Use substitution method for two variables.

Identity

x² + y² = (x + y)² − 2xy

Alternative Approach

You can also find xy and use identity.

questions.question: Simplify: [(9x + 4y)² - (9x - 4y)²] div 24x
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

= [(9x+4y) − (9x−4y)] × [(9x+4y) + (9x−4y)]

= (8y)(18x) = 144xy

Divide by 24x ⇒ 144xy / 24x = 6y

**∴ Answer = 6y**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

[(9x + 4y)² − (9x − 4y)²] ÷ 24x

**Formula used:**

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let a = (9x + 4y), b = (9x − 4y)

⇒ a − b = 8y

⇒ a + b = 18x

⇒ Expression = (8y)(18x) ÷ 24x

⇒ = 144xy ÷ 24x

⇒ = 6y

**∴ The correct answer is 6y.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Simplification Tip

Cancel common factors before final step.

Quick Trick

Use (a+b)² − (a−b)² = 4ab directly.

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 36°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 3 : 5, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By quadrilateral angle bisector property, ∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2.

⇒ 36° = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2 ⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 72°

Given the ratio ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 5.

⇒ Total ratio parts = 3 + 5 = 8 parts = 72° ⇒ 1 part = 9°

Difference in ratio = 5 − 3 = 2 parts ⇒ 2 × 9° = 18°.

**∴ The correct answer is 18°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In quadrilateral PQRS, bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at T.

∠STR = 36° and ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 5

 

 
 
• 
 
•

**Calculations:**

In ΔSTR, the sum of interior angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠TSR + ∠TRS + ∠STR = 180°

Since ST and RT are the angle bisectors of ∠S and ∠R respectively:

⇒ ∠S/2 + ∠R/2 + 36° = 180°

⇒ (∠S + ∠R) ÷ 2 = 144°

⇒ ∠S + ∠R = 288°

The sum of all interior angles in quadrilateral PQRS is 360°.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 288° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 72°

Given the ratio ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 5, let ∠P = 3x and ∠Q = 5x.

⇒ 3x + 5x = 72°

⇒ 8x = 72° ⇒ x = 9°

We need to find the difference between ∠Q and ∠P:

⇒ ∠Q − ∠P = 5x − 3x = 2x

⇒ 2 × 9° = 18°

**∴ The correct answer is 18°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Bisector Theorem in Quadrilaterals

If the bisectors of two adjacent angles (e.g., ∠C and ∠D) of a quadrilateral meet at a point P, the angle formed at P is exactly half the sum of the other two angles: ∠CPD = (∠A + ∠B) ÷ 2.

Sum of Angles in a Quadrilateral

The sum of interior angles of any simple quadrilateral is always 360°. This is derived using the general formula for any polygon with n sides: Sum = (n − 2) × 180°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

If all four vertices of a quadrilateral lie on the circumference of a circle, it is called cyclic. The sum of its opposite angles is always equal to 180°.

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 2, 4 and 4 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of (2, 4, 4) = 4 units.

Efficiencies: A = 4 ÷ 2 = 2, B = 4 ÷ 4 = 1, C = 4 ÷ 4 = 1.

Combined efficiency = 2 + 1 + 1 = 4 units/day.

Time to finish the original work = Total work ÷ Combined efficiency = 4 ÷ 4 = 1 day.

Time to finish thrice the original work = 1 × 3 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

questions.question: Find the single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 6%, 5% and 11%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discount formula for two discounts: D = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100

Effective discount for 6% and 5% = 6 + 5 − (6 × 5) ÷ 100 = 11 − 0.3 = 10.7%

Now, find successive discount for 10.7% and 11%:

Final single discount = 10.7 + 11 − (10.7 × 11) ÷ 100 = 21.7 − 1.177 = 20.523%

**∴ The correct answer is 20.52%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three consecutive discounts are 6%, 5% and 11%.

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100)

Single equivalent discount % = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100

questions.question: ₹5,575 is divided among X, Y and Z in such a way that if ₹85, ₹65 and ₹61 is deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 5:11:20. Find the difference between the original shares of Y and Z.

After deduction ratio = 5 : 11 : 20

Total = 5575 ⇒ 36x + 211 = 5575

36x = 5364 ⇒ x = 149

Difference (Y−Z) = (11x+65) − (20x+61) = 4 − 9x = −1337

**∴ Answer = 1337**

Total amount = ₹5575

After deduction ratio = 5 : 11 : 20

Original = Adjusted + deducted amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original shares = 5x+85, 11x+65, 20x+61

⇒ Total ⇒ 5x+85 + 11x+65 + 20x+61 = 5575

⇒ 36x + 211 = 5575

⇒ 36x = 5364 ⇒ x = 149

⇒ Y = 11×149 + 65 = 1704

⇒ Z = 20×149 + 61 = 3041

⇒ Difference = 3041 − 1704 = 1337

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1337.**

questions.question: {The simplified value of } sqrt{256} - sqrt{169} + (sqrt{144} - sqrt{25})² { is}:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Evaluate all the perfect square roots directly mentally:

⇒ √256 = 16, √169 = 13, √144 = 12, √25 = 5

⇒ Substitute these values directly: 16 − 13 + (12 − 5)²

⇒ 3 + (7)²

⇒ 3 + 49 = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: √256 − √169 + (√144 − √25)²

**Method Used:**

Apply the BODMAS rule: evaluate Order (square roots), then Brackets, followed by Exponents, and finally Addition/Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Find the values of individual square roots:

⇒ √256 = 16

⇒ √169 = 13

⇒ √144 = 12

⇒ √25 = 5

⇒ Substitute the values back into the main expression:

⇒ 16 − 13 + (12 − 5)²

⇒ Simplify the bracket first (12 − 5):

⇒ 16 − 13 + (7)²

⇒ Evaluate the square of 7:

⇒ 16 − 13 + 49

⇒ Perform subtraction and addition from left to right:

⇒ 3 + 49

⇒ 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the correct sequence for operations: Brackets, Order (Powers and Roots), Division × Multiplication (left-to-right), and Addition − Subtraction (left-to-right).

Perfect Squares up to 20

Memorising squares up to 30 significantly improves calculation speed in competitive exams. For example: 14² = 196, 15² = 225, 16² = 256, 17² = 289.

Basic Algebraic Identities

Although arithmetic simplification is best here, knowing (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² is essential for cases involving unknown variables.
</p

questions.question: Find the ratio between the fourth proportional of 4, 8 and 19 to the mean proportional of 9 and 4.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Fourth proportional of a, b, c is calculated as (b × c) ÷ a.

Fourth proportional of 4, 8, and 19 = (8 × 19) ÷ 4 = 38.

Mean proportional of a and b is calculated as √(a × b).

Mean proportional of 9 and 4 = √(9 × 4) = √36 = 6.

Required Ratio = 38 : 6 = 19 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 19 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First set of numbers: 4, 8, 19

Second set of numbers: 9, 4

 
 Fourth Proportional
 x = (8 × 19) ÷ 4 = 38
 
 
 Mean Proportional
 y = √(9 × 4) = 6
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 38 : 6 = 19 : 3

**Formula Used:**

Fourth proportional (x) of a, b, c: a / b = c / x ⇒ x = (b × c) ÷ a

Mean proportional (y) of a, b: y = √(a × b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the fourth proportional of 4, 8, and 19 be x.

⇒ 4 / 8 = 19 / x

⇒ x = (8 × 19) ÷ 4

⇒ x = 2 × 19 = 38

⇒ Let the mean proportional of 9 and 4 be y.

⇒ y = √(9 × 4)

⇒ y = √36 = 6

⇒ Required Ratio = x : y

⇒ Ratio = 38 : 6

⇒ Ratio = 19 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 19 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fourth Proportional

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a : b = c : d), then 'd' is known as the fourth proportional to a, b, and c. It can be found using the formula d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b = b : c), then 'b' is called the mean proportional between a and c. It is calculated as b = √(a × c).

Third Proportional

In the continued proportion a : b = b : c, the term 'c' is known as the third proportional to a and b. It can be found using the formula c = b² ÷ a.
</p

questions.question: Find the smallest number which when increased by 10 is completely divisible by 12, 15, 18 and 20.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required number + 10 must be divisible by 12, 15, 18, 20

LCM = 180

So number + 10 = 180 ⇒ number = 170

**∴ Answer = 170**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number + 10 divisible by 12, 15, 18, 20

**Concept Used:**

Use LCM for multiple divisibility

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12 = 2²×3, 15 = 3×5, 18 = 2×3², 20 = 2²×5

⇒ LCM = 2²×3²×5 = 180

⇒ Smallest such number ⇒ number + 10 = 180

⇒ number = 180 − 10 = 170

**∴ The correct answer is 170.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Rule

LCM gives smallest number divisible by all given numbers.

Remainder Trick

Adjust the number before applying LCM.

Smallest Value

Take first multiple of LCM.

questions.question: The diagonal of a rectangle is sqrt{89} cm and its area is 40 { cm}² . Find the perimeter of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let sides = a, b

a² + b² = 89 and ab = 40

(a + b)² = 89 + 2×40 = 169

a + b = 13

Perimeter = 2(a + b) = 26

**∴ Answer = 26 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diagonal = √89 cm

Area = 40 cm²

**Formula used:**

Diagonal² = a² + b², Area = ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ a² + b² = 89

⇒ ab = 40

⇒ (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ = 89 + 80 = 169

⇒ a + b = 13

⇒ Perimeter = 2(a + b) = 26 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 26 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Identity

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

Rectangle Property

Diagonal² = sum of squares of sides

Quick Trick

Find (a + b) first, then multiply by 2

questions.question: A camp has provisions for 20 pupils for 12 days. In how many days will the same provisions be used up, if the strength of the camp is increased to 80 pupils?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total quantity of provisions remains constant, so we use the inverse proportion rule: M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

⇒ 20 × 12 = 80 × D₂

⇒ 240 = 80 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of pupils (M₁) = 20

Initial number of days (D₁) = 12

Final number of pupils (M₂) = 80

**Formula Used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

 
 Provisions
 20 Pupils × 12 Days
 =
 
 Provisions
 80 Pupils × ? Days
 

 Same Total Quantity

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total provisions available = 20 × 12 = 240 pupil-days

⇒ Let the new provisions last for D₂ days for 80 pupils

⇒ 80 × D₂ = 240

⇒ D₂ = 240 ÷ 80

⇒ D₂ = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

When one quantity increases while the other decreases such that their product remains constant. Formula: x₁ × y₁ = x₂ × y₂.

Direct Proportion

When two quantities increase or decrease together in the same ratio. Formula: x₁ ÷ y₁ = x₂ ÷ y₂.

MDH Rule (Chain Rule)

Used to solve complex variations in time and work questions directly: (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

questions.question: The distance between points A and B is 933 km. Namit travels from A to B at a speed of 70 km/hr and returns at a speed of 111 km/hr. Calculate Namit’s average speed for the entire journey (rounded off to two decimal places).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed (equal distance) = 2ab / (a + b)

= (2 × 70 × 111) / (70 + 111)

= 15540 / 181 ≈ 85.86 km/hr

**∴ Answer ≈ 85.86 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance one way = 933 km

Speed onward = 70 km/hr, return = 111 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time forward = 933 / 70 = 13.33 hr

⇒ Time return = 933 / 111 = 8.41 hr

⇒ Total distance = 1866 km

⇒ Total time ≈ 21.74 hr

⇒ Average speed = 1866 ÷ 21.74 ≈ 85.86 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer ≈ 85.86 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Important Rule

For equal distances, average speed = 2ab / (a + b)

Common Mistake

Do not take simple average of speeds.

Tip

Use shortcut formula to save time.

questions.question: The product of the present ages of Ram and Lalith is 216 years, and their age ratio is 6 : 1. Find the difference in their ages.
questions.solution:

Product = 6x² = 216 ⇒ x² = 36 ⇒ x = 6

Ages = 36 and 6

Difference = 30

**Given:**

Product of ages = 216

Ratio = 6 : 1

**Formula used:**

Let ages = 6x and x

**Calculation:**

⇒ 6x × x = 216

⇒ 6x² = 216

⇒ x² = 36 ⇒ x = 6

⇒ Ages = 36 and 6

⇒ Difference = 36 − 6 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assume ages as multiples of a common variable.

Product Equation

Find actual ages and subtract.

questions.question: The expenditure of Sudha is 200% more than her savings. If her expenditure decreases by 10% and savings increase by 34%, then by what percentage does her income increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expenditure = 200% more ⇒ E = 3S

Take S = 1 ⇒ E = 3 ⇒ Income = 4

New E = 3 × 0.90 = 2.7, New S = 1 × 1.34 = 1.34

New income = 2.7 + 1.34 = 4.04

Increase = 0.04 / 4 × 100 = 1%

**∴ Answer = 1% increase**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expenditure = 200% more than savings

Expenditure ↓ 10%, Savings ↑ 34%

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let savings = S

⇒ Expenditure = S + 2S = 3S

⇒ Initial income = 3S + S = 4S

⇒ New expenditure = 3S × 0.90 = 2.7S

⇒ New savings = S × 1.34 = 1.34S

⇒ New income = 2.7S + 1.34S = 4.04S

⇒ Increase = 4.04S − 4S = 0.04S

⇒ % increase = (0.04 / 4) × 100 = 1%

**∴ The correct answer is 1% increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Percentage Change

New value = Old × (1 ± % change)

Key Trick

Assume simple values to simplify calculations.
